messages.subject: RE: [GGIR] error part 2
parts:
Hello Jessie,

qwindow_dateformat = "%d-%m-%Y", is correct, but you have semicolumn separated values in the activity diary, which looks like this: " ;DATE;AStartSchool1;AstartRecess1;"

Please use MS Excel or similar to convert your csv file from semicolumn to column separated format, such that the values look like: ",DATE,AStartSchool1,AstartRecess1,"
You can check this with notepad or similar text editing tools.

This is a quick attempt to show how I converted it:

First I open the file in Excel and see:



when I then select first column, go to Data and then to "Text to columns" 


I am able to select semicolon as the column separators, after which the column is split. If I then save the file the file is comma separated. You can check this by opening the file in notepad or similar.

Best regards, Vincent

Hello Jessie,

I am replying with the GGIR google group in CC again, because I never reply to personal messages with questions about GGIR unless the recipient is a client. This is crucial for others to be able to learn from these conversations.

I have solved the problem with the csv file, so this works now and I get an output, but I cannot find my seperated values that I created in the csv file anywhere in that output. 

I am not sure I follow, do you mean that your part 2 results are not segmented per part of the day?

Is there something that needs to be added still?

I found this in the script
g.convert.part2.long(daySUMMARY)

Would that need to be integretad somewhere?

No, these are internal functions.
To investigate can you do (update dataformat according to our needs):
qwindow = g.conv.actlog(qwindow = "your_activitylog.csv", qwindow_dateformat="%d-%m-%Y", epochSize = 5)
print(qwindow)
If this shows a lot of information in the console with qwindow values for each day of each recording then that is a good sign as it indicates that the activity log is recognised.
Best wishes,
Vincent
